[Erowid Note: 
The term "acid" has been used as a common name for d-LSD since the 1960s. Although confusion associated with newer psychoactive substances has lead some people to use the term "acid" to refer to anything LSD-like or anything psychedelic on blotter or sold in drops, we believe this represents an error and not a useful evolution in language.]
This is my report on my experience with the
Lysergamide 1-P-LSD. I am resonably experienced with psilocybin mushrooms, MDMA, 2ci, LSD aswell as cocaine and amphetamines, valium and alcohol.
My freind Robbie ordered the 1-p-LSD from on online vendor and it arrived in the post a few days later, we were all excited as we hadnt tripped in a few months and hadnt taken acid since the previous november due to unavailability. Personally looking forward to the unique lysergic perspective, and my aim for the trip is to think about major things that have happened in the last few months including my giving up alcohol after a life threatning bout of withdrawl. I also hope to be inspired and work through creative ideas with my freinds about our new trance/psychdelic dance band. When we heard that 1-P-lsd was almost a perfect match for its more famous cousin, we were overjoyed.
June 2015
14:15: me and Robbie drop 100mc of the substance each in blotter form and wait, we are both excited and feeling entrepid, we discuss how lucky we are to do this, like in the 60s when LSD was still legal, we remember thinking how good it must have been and count our blessings that we can experience it.
14:20 I make a note saying 'possible shift'. I remember feeling a distinct tingle that I couldnt quite attribute to the pollen hash I was smoking. We discuss if this is physiologically possible, probably not we decide.
14:30: I made my last note in shaky writing: DEFFINITE SHIFT! And I remember at that point I was starting to feel a warm energy flowing through me in a sort of rippley buzz, I feel very happy and all feelings of anxiety have completely vannished, at the minuite things are going smooth and I'm quite amazed how good I feel about the situation. I have been prone to anxiety in the past following an amphetamine habit and have sometimes found shift in headspace uncomfortable (for example with cannabis this happened for a while). Over the next hour or so the headspace expands and the visuals start, remeniscent of some clean acid I've had in the past, with flowing geometric spira, very angular and symetrical, colourful. Like tiles, Tesselation is the word I believe. These visuals contrast with other acid I've had where the CEVs consist of rolling pictures and scenes, synesthetic explosions of colour like poster paints and faces, the visuals from this 1p covered my entire vision at once and spun like cogs in psychedlic clockwork, beautifull all the same.
Around 15:10 I remember things getting a little intense, I was forgetting what I was doing and everything was fizzing out and dissolving, much less animated than the lead up to ego death on other acid I've had (watching the whole world come pouring in the front door, and riding the snake to oblivion).
At this point I'm wrestling with the idea that this is a new unexplored chemical and thus the safety profile is unknown, in my slightly confused state this is hard to wrap my head around and I smoke hashish frantically through a glass pipe, this helps ground me and I rationalise that a lysergimide is probably very safe, and before long I am feeling very good once again. We decide to telephone our freind adam and he decides to come over and drop a tab. Me and robbie smoke cannabis and listen to DreadZone : 360. Adam arrives and drops a tab.
Time at this point is a little off but I geuss adam dropped and was up by 1645. We crused a few hour listening to music and smoking dope, discussing the chemical and its similarities to, and differences from LSD adam and robbie say its exactly the same and I argue the visuals are very different (at least from other stuff I've had) and we reason that its untestable and probably down to set and setting
we reason that its untestable and probably down to set and setting
.
22:00 I go on a quick bike ride to get munchies from my parents house and find it easy, when I get back I drop another half tab (Robbie has already dropped another half, but I was waiting to get the journey over). Before long I am starting to feel much more groovy and the boys put on a film Seven Psychopaths, I'm in no mood for a film and pretty much ignore it and thats when the trip became very interesting. A lightning storm had started outside, not just any lighting storm but the most impressive lightning I have ever seen, out of all four corners of the house lighting up the sky above Edinburgh, huge daggers of electricity ten miles across were lighting up the town around us, flashes that lit up the town like dayinght and huge skeletal hand reaching down from the sky to scrape and tickle the ground, it was beautiful and we felt extremely lucky to witness such a thing from such a good vantage point on acid. We were aware we might never see anything like it. Then something very weird happened, we say a huge ball of light hovering amidst the storm, not moving, big enough to be a chopper but the way it hung was very strange, it got brighter and brighter but not like it was getting bigger, me and the boys started freaking out abit as we thought that a) we might be witnessing a geological phenonima to do with the storm or b) there was something paranormal going on. The way the acid visual framed the light made it very oddly shaped and threw just enough doubt into our brains as to what we were witnessing. I had heard of group hallucinations and even though I lend no believe to notions such as that or to the paranormal, it was a very strange minuite or so, until it became apparent that it was indeed a helicopter. At this point we get a phone call from our other freind sean, him and his girlfreind were refused entry to the club and they are heading to us, this is around 02:00 am.
02:30 sean and his girlfreind arrive, very drunk and loving life it is good to see them as we havnt hung out in a while, the feeling of oneness is tangeable before long sean falls asleep and the rest of us listen to music, chat and eat more acid. A few hours later we reason we should call it a night, we watched the sun rise and a beautiful morning develops. Everyone goes home but the last tab I've eaten takes full effect. I go to my parents house and stay up the entire following day, I eat another tab but dont get much more off of it, I eat cannabutter in an effort to ease muscle tension and get some sleep.
Final notes: very similar to LSD, a bit more of a chemically feeling than acid, along with neck pain and some muscle tension, when I was hungry it was very uncomfortable, and thirsty too. A really nice chemical a lot of fun and nice to be with freinds on, all the factors were right and it did the job as well in my opinion as the real thing would have, and I probably couldnt pick it out in a lineup.
